heading.title: Feedback & Evaluation
heading.subtitle: Review student submissions and provide personalized feedback

submissions.answer: Active listening involves paying full attention, showing empathy, and providing feedback to the speaker. It builds trust and improves understanding.
submissions.instructorFeedback: The quiz was very helpful and practical!

submissions.answer: I created a priority matrix and scheduled tasks based on urgency and impact. This helped me meet the deadline without stress.
I tracked expenses, built a 50/30/20 budget, and set savings goals for the next quarter. The worksheet clarified my spending.
submissions.instructorFeedback: Great use of the 50/30/20 framework. Consider adding a buffer for irregular expenses.
